source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, turn the UID on and verify it is lit, then turn it off and verify it is not lit.
source_snapshot.criteria: UID behavior should be as expected.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL correctly recognizes a management write plus physical observation, but assumes an unspecified IndicatorLED PATCH/GET, omits target/schema discovery, trusted transport, exact light mode/location, baseline, bounded duration, audit and mandatory restoration.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly adds exact chassis/LED mapping, protected management access, point-of-action approval, separate UI/API and physical evidence, wrong-LED stops and restoration.

old_problem: The core UID On/Off operation is clear, but the executable contract was left pending for target-specific LED mapping, Redfish property/enum, baseline, duration, observer and recovery. DeepSeek's generic IndicatorLED concept also ignores that modern Redfish deprecates that enum property in favor of LocationIndicatorActive and cannot prove the correct physical LED changed.
disposition_reason: The source provides a complete two-state functional intent. Use the actual WebUI UID control, pair each state with management readback and mandatory human/camera physical evidence, and restore the approved baseline. Prefer schema-supported `LocationIndicatorActive`; use deprecated `IndicatorLED` only when the target advertises it and Project maps its enum. Chassis mapping, appearance and duration are runtime configuration, not an unresolved engineering decision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 945, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record, physical row 946 and next pending row 947 were directly reviewed; next pending identity was verified as Functionality row 947 / variant c04e36eb37762c08.

Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require UID On and Off plus actual visibility. The missing target/location/mode/duration values can be safely parameterized while preserving both transitions and restoration.

DMTF Redfish Data Model defines `LocationIndicatorActive` as the read-write state of an indicator used to physically locate a resource. Writing it updates legacy IndicatorLED when supported; the Resource Guide marks IndicatorLED deprecated in favor of LocationIndicatorActive.

A management value or HTTP success cannot prove physical visibility or correct chassis, while a visible light alone cannot prove the intended control path. Synchronized WebUI, schema readback, audit and physical evidence are independently required.

ED-08, ED-20, ED-23, ED-25 and ED-33 through ED-38 plus the user's physical-LED rule retain actual visual/manual evidence, explicit approval, no substitution, safe recovery and engineer-owned verdict.

test_case.test_name: Toggle the intended chassis UID in WebUI, verify management and physical On/Off states, and restore baseline
test_case.purpose: Verify that the actual BMC WebUI System Identify/UID control targets the intended chassis locator LED, produces the approved visible On appearance and Off appearance, agrees with schema-supported management readback and returns to its approved baseline without changing power, fault/status LEDs or another chassis.
required_package: Immutable BMC/SUT/chassis/rack identity, firmware/WebUI build, trusted TLS, protected credentials and exact Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs UID control mapping

Service-root-discovered exact Chassis/System resource and advertised schema support for `LocationIndicatorActive`, or documented legacy `IndicatorLED` enum mapping when that deprecated property is the only supported control
Physical UID location, label, color and approved solid/blink On appearance, Off appearance and evidence framing that distinguishes adjacent power/fault/status LEDs
Approved baseline Off state, bounded On observation duration, human operator or approved live camera at the target and synchronized timestamps
Point-of-action approval for one On and one Off/restore transition, preserved audit collection and wrong-LED/persistent-state recovery path
test_case.test_command: MEDIUM-RISK VISUAL INDICATOR WRITE; no action is authorized by this review. Preserve logs. Prove immutable BMC/chassis/rack identity, exact physical UID location and baseline Off through actual WebUI screenshot, schema-supported readback and timestamped operator/camera image. Prefer the advertised `LocationIndicatorActive=false`; treat legacy `IndicatorLED=Off` only as a documented compatibility mapping. After approval, use the actual WebUI UID control once to set On; capture request/task/audit outcome, refreshed WebUI state and `LocationIndicatorActive=true` or approved legacy Lit/Blinking value, while the physical observer records the exact LED location/color/mode for the bounded interval and confirms power/fault/status LEDs did not change. Then use the actual WebUI control once to set Off/restore; capture the same management evidence and physical UID not-lit confirmation. Do not use API-only substitution, `curl -k`, process-visible credentials, an assumed `/Chassis/system`, repeated writes or any power/other-LED control.
test_case.expected_result: The baseline UID is Off both in actual WebUI/schema readback and at the mapped physical chassis LED. The single approved On transition changes only the intended UID to the Project-defined visible appearance for the bounded interval and management readback agrees. The single Off transition restores management state and the physical UID to baseline. Target identity, timestamps and audit events correlate, no other chassis or power/fault/status indicator changes, host power remains unchanged and the UID is not left asserted.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact chassis mapping, actual WebUI operation, one approved On and one Off/restore, schema-valid readback/audit after each, timestamped physical evidence for the correct LED and proof of no unrelated indicator/power change. HTTP success, API-only state, WebUI-only icon, or physical observation alone cannot pass. Wrong LED/chassis, unapproved mode, stale/mismatched readback, missing physical evidence, repeated writes or failed restoration is FAIL and stops. Missing mapping/observer/schema/duration is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Correlate BMC asset, chassis/rack location and physical UID label before any write; an operator/camera must frame enough context to exclude a neighboring system or power/fault LED.
Obtain point-of-action approval for the exact On/Off plan, execute each transition once and never automatically retry or probe alternate resources after a mismatch.
Use actual WebUI and protected trusted transport. Do not use `curl -k`, expose credentials, assume resource IDs, or use deprecated IndicatorLED unless the target advertises and maps it.
Preserve audit/SEL evidence. Stop immediately on wrong LED, unexpected color/blink, another indicator/power change, stale management state or loss of physical observation.
Management readback cannot replace physical confirmation; physical light cannot replace the WebUI/control/readback trail. Both evidence planes are mandatory for On and Off.
Restoration to approved baseline is mandatory. If Off does not persist, do not spam toggles or power-cycle; follow the validated indicator recovery path and escalate.
expected_evidence: Approval, immutable target/chassis/rack/WebUI/schema identity, UID physical map, baseline state, bounded duration and synchronized observer/camera context
Actual WebUI On operation and refreshed state, schema-supported readback/task/audit plus timestamped physical UID location/color/mode evidence
Actual WebUI Off/restore operation and refreshed state, schema readback/task/audit plus timestamped physical not-lit/baseline evidence
Proof host PowerState and adjacent power/fault/status LEDs and other chassis remained unchanged
Preserved logs, no secret exposure, final baseline comparison and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target/LED, unexpected mode, stale mismatch or failed Off, stop all further writes and preserve evidence. Use the already validated same WebUI/resource only once under explicit recovery authorization to restore the captured baseline, then verify management and physical state. Do not guess another property/resource, retry repeatedly or power-cycle the host. If persistence remains, warn onsite personnel that the locator is unreliable and escalate to the BMC/vendor owner.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define the same UID On/Off visual function. Property/version selection and physical mapping are implementation bindings, not conflicting purposes.

blocked.reason: The target function and transitions are defined by source and DMTF. Exact resource/property, appearance, duration and observer are finite Project readiness inputs.

pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; VISUAL INDICATOR WRITE WITH PHYSICAL CHECK; NO WEBUI, REDFISH OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification 2025.3
external_authorities.application: Defines `LocationIndicatorActive` as the read-write physical-location indicator and states that writes update legacy IndicatorLED when supported.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide 2025.2
external_authorities.application: Marks Chassis IndicatorLED deprecated in favor of LocationIndicatorActive and supplies legacy enum semantics for compatible targets.

project_authority: The Project/vendor package binds the exact chassis/WebUI/resource, physical LED appearance, supported property, duration, observer and recovery and owns PASS/FAIL. These parameters no longer require a separate engineering classification decision.
